description: Change the SIA receiver (saved with AlarmSave): enabled, tcp, udp, ack_timestamp (desired values), port 1024..49151 (not 80/843), account (max 32), supervision_min 0..1440, partition_sensor {partition 1.., usens (0 = none)}. simulate = a DC-03 test event like "Nri1/BA01" (burglary alarm partition 1 zone 1) - drives the partition state and its usens; reset_counters=true. TCP on/off takes effect after a restart. Editor/admin level.
name: myio_alarm_set
title: Configure the alarm receiver
